title: Warranty - Phones, Domestic Service
text:
This warranty explains domestic service for phones bought from our store, whether you ordered online or bought in person. When service is requested in the United States, where the phone was sold, phones are covered for 12 months from the date of purchase against defects in materials and workmanship.

What the warranty covers

The warranty covers the phone itself, the battery inside it, and the charger and cable that came in the box, against faults in materials and workmanship that appear under normal use. Typical covered faults are a screen that stops responding to touch, buttons or ports that stop working, a battery that will no longer hold a charge, and a phone that will not turn on although it has not been dropped or wet. The charger and cable are covered only when they are the ones that came in the box, and faults that appear in the first days after purchase are handled in the same way as later ones. For domestic service, these faults are covered for the whole period stated above.

What the warranty does not cover

The warranty does not cover cracked screens, liquid damage, damage from drops or other accidents, or normal wear such as scratches and a worn finish. It does not cover faults caused by software or apps you installed, phones whose identification number has been removed or changed, or phones repaired by anyone other than an approved service center. Lost or stolen phones are not covered either, and accessories bought separately, such as cases and screen protectors, carry their own terms. These limits apply to domestic service in the same way.

How to make a claim

To make a claim, contact our customer service team online or visit the service desk in any of our stores with your proof of purchase. Describe the fault and, if you can, send a short video or photo that shows it. A team member may ask you to restart the phone or run a simple check before the claim is logged in our system. For domestic service, the team then tells you where the phone must be sent and what happens next. Keep a note of the claim number we give you, and quote it whenever you contact us about the repair.

Repair, replacement or refund

If the claim is accepted, the phone is repaired, or replaced with the same or a comparable phone when it cannot be repaired. A refund is offered only when neither is possible. Back up the phone and remove any SIM card before you send it, because some repairs reset the phone and we cannot keep cards or cases that come with it. A repaired or replaced phone is sent back to you by tracked delivery, or you can collect it from the service desk where you handed it in. These options are the same for domestic service.

Proof of purchase and transfer

Keep your proof of purchase for as long as the phone is covered, because it shows where and when the phone was bought, and it is the first thing a technician asks for when you request domestic service. The warranty stays with the phone if you give it away or sell it, as long as the next owner can show the original proof of purchase. If you bought online with your account, our team can find the sale there if the proof is lost.
